hook.text_top: This anime chase never slows down.
hook.text_bottom: Watch what he does to the blade...
hook.voice: This anime chase never slows down.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Low camera skimming the road, tracking backward at high speed. The fighter sprints toward camera at frame-left; the swordsman runs behind him, white robe flaring.
shots.voice: Shot 1. The camera skims the road and tracks backward, so both fighters run straight at us.

shots.excerpt: Fast push-in to an upside-down close-up of the fighter's face against the sky: white hair hanging down, dark-red under-eye band, a dangerous smile.
shots.voice: Shot 5. A fast push-in on an upside-down face. That one detail makes the vault feel real.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off low shot by a concrete pillar: the sedan flips upside down through frame, scraping the road in a burst of orange sparks.
shots.voice: Shot 9. A locked-off camera lets the car flip right through frame, with sparks for impact.

shots.excerpt: Close-up: the fighter pinches the flat of the steel blade between bare fingers, grinning at camera; gold guard and black glove at frame-left.
highlight: pinches the flat of the steel blade
shots.voice: Shot 17. He catches the blade with bare fingers. Naming the exact grip keeps his hand on the steel.

shots.excerpt: Extreme close-up filling the frame with only the fighter's two amber-gold eyes and the dark-red chevron band beneath; very slow push-in, the eyes narrow.
shots.voice: Shot 18. Everything stops. An extreme close-up on the eyes with a very slow push-in.

shots.excerpt: Wide side view in mid-air, huge sunset skyline: both fly at each other, punch and parry, the swordsman's white robe billowing open like a cape.
shots.voice: Shot 24. A wide side view in mid-air, with the robe billowing like a cape for the final hit.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
